title: WiWo
headline: I led product on WiWo and decided how often it could buzz you
summary: WiWo noticed when a phone walked into a store and, if there was an offer, sent a push.
description: As product lead on WiWo, a store-offers app, I decided what it would refuse to send, and measured before I changed it.
facts: Co-founder, head of product, two engineers
outcome: The cooldown and delivery windows shipped in May, after a two-week baseline. My one success metric, offer saves per walk-in, couldn't be measured then because saves lived elsewhere; the app was later changed to log them.

hero.alt: A phone lock screen with one push reading Welcome to Corner Market, next to the offer card it opens: a free coffee with any sandwich.
hero.caption: The moment, with an invented store.

story: The co-founder built the prototype, the mobile engineer built the app and the backend engineer built the developer platform.
My strategy named who WiWo was not for: the retailer who wants to blast everyone who walks by, which is email marketing with a geofence.

calls.why: The developer who embeds it comes first and won't ship what they'd regret. Then the retailer, who controls how often it fires. Then the shopper.
A per-store cooldown, so one walk-in doesn't buzz twice, and delivery windows each store sets by day and hour. The mobile engineer built both.
A two-week baseline before the cooldown served as the control. It showed iPhones and Android phones behaved very differently, and overlapping store outlines at one test site multiplied pushes.
When someone got no offer, every part looked fine. So I built an outcome debugger that follows one phone through each step and names the first that came up empty.

images.alt: A store settings card with a cooldown switched on and delivery windows set to Monday to Friday, 7:00 am to 8:00 pm.
images.caption: A store's two limits, with invented values.

images.alt: A verdict for one invented device: location reports, walk-in and offer request passed, push not sent because no offer was available.
images.caption: The outcome debugger, with invented data.
